items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: once George Orrendorf got -- George went with me, and you know what I did? I got the Kleagle of the Ku Klux Klan to get him out of jail.

ctx.x: It could have been George, but George came here from Chicago.
He might have been playing with them at one time, George Orendorff.
